live.teamHint: Staff call the next guest from their own phone.
live.tv: Pair a TV in your waiting room
live.tvHint: Show who is being called. Optional.

alerts.phone: Guests see their place in line on their phone and it updates by itself.
alerts.browser: They get a browser alert when you call them. On iPhone they must first tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
alerts.tv: A TV in your waiting room shows the number being called.
